title: The threshold for the asymmetric vertex-Ramsey property in randomly perturbed graphs
summary: For $r \geq 2$ and graphs $H_1, \ldots, H_r, G$, we say that $G$ is $(H_1, \ldots, H_r)$ vertex-Ramsey, or $(H_1, \ldots, H_r)_v$-Ramsey, if whenever we colour the vertices of $G$ with colours from the set $[r]=\{1,2, \ldots, r\}$ there exists $j \in [r]$ such that some copy of $H_j$ in $G$ is monochromatic in colour $j$. Given any fixed collection of graphs $H_1, \ldots, H_r$, Luczak, Ruciński and Voigt and Kreuter determined in the 1990s the threshold edge probability $p$ at which the binomial random graph $G(n,p)$ becomes $(H_1, \ldots, H_r)_v$-Ramsey.
